capabilities: Scan vault or folder frontmatter for drift
Detect lookalike keys and near-duplicate values
Detect mixed value types and date formats
Report rare property keys and look up keys by value
Copy the report as markdown and dismiss false positives
disambiguation: Not a cleanup tool; it only reports frontmatter drift and never writes to or modifies any note.
extras: Strictly read-only and offline with no telemetry; README promotes a paid done-for-you vault cleanup and a guide from Atlas Creative; manual installation only.
problem: Obsidian gives no way to spot property naming and value inconsistencies that accumulate across many notes.
summary: Frontmatter audit report that scans a vault for lookalike property keys, near-duplicate values, mixed types and date formats, and rare keys.
